lineOfBusinessVocabulary.label: Enterprise shared services (not attributable to one line of business)

functionTierMembership.front: Passenger engagement and experience: booking, check-in, loyalty, disruption communication, contact centre, onboard service
functionTierMembership.middle: Core operating engine: flight, crew and airport operations, MRO, network planning, revenue management, cargo, safety
functionTierMembership.back: Enterprise support: finance, HR, procurement, legal, corporate IT, real estate, strategy

functions.judgementCall: Placed in front because it is passenger-facing service delivery. A operations-led view would call it middle. Worth a decision — it moves catering spend between the front and middle slices of every cube.
Placed in middle because in an airline safety is an operating function, not a support one. A pure corporate-functions view would call it back office.
Fuel is both an operating input and a hedged commodity managed by treasury. Placed in middle on the operating reading; a finance-led view would split it.
